title: casselia davurica
intro: Casselia davurica, commonly known as Russian wormwood, is a plant species belonging to the family Boraginaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, menstrual cramps, and other conditions. The therapeutic actions of Casselia davurica include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve pain, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
